title: resources/subscribe request params
description: Params for the legacy MCP resources/subscribe method as accepted by Labby. Mirrors rmcp 3.1.0 SubscribeRequestParams (rmcp-3.1.0/src/model.rs:1806-1815). Deprecated for protocol version 2026-07-28, whose clients use subscriptions/listen instead.

uri.description: Gateway-form URI of the resource to subscribe to. Must be a member of UpstreamPool::subscribable_resource_uris_snapshot() (contract C-2). Local Labby URIs are never members and are rejected.

_meta.description: Protocol-level request metadata (SEP-1319). Passed through unmodified; Labby attaches no semantics to it for this method.
